about: Golden answers for the tag classifier eval (scripts/eval-tags.mjs): does each school earn music, arts and science & tech by the rules in docs/data-sources.md? The answers are the owner's decisions, signed off 2026-11-13. source_sha is the saved source text they were checked against (scripts/fetch-tag-sources.js); a different one means the pages changed since.

notes.stem: Changed to yes 2026-11-16: a computer programming class is named, which the rule counts.

notes.music: Band is listed under before/after school programming: a club doesn't count.
notes.arts: Changed to yes 2026-11-16: theater and visual art are named under enrichment, apart from the after-school list. Judgment call: no grades are given, in a K–8 school; counted, as its STEAM Lab is. Drama Club is a club and doesn't count.

notes.stem: Changed to yes 2026-11-16: the website lists S.T.E.A.M. as a minor subject, a class beyond the core. Thin: a menu label only.

notes.arts: Judgment call: art for all students is the required class, and the review says drama and dance are still being built. A yearly musical is not a program.
notes.stem: Changed to no 2026-11-16: the 7th-grade architecture program is not a science or tech academy, lab or class. Its Federal Magnet program alone doesn't count.
Federal Magnet program alone doesn't count.

notes.music: "Mini Band Share" in a newsletter is a one-off event, not a program.
notes.arts: Changed to yes 2026-11-16: 7th and 8th graders choose an arts concentration.
notes.stem: An ordinary science lab doesn't count, and the STEM lab was not yet built when the review was written.
Rests on the school's STEAM Department page: coding, web design and robotics, and STEAM is one of the majors students audition for. The STEAM club in the review would not count by itself.
